description: Integrate with AWS S3 to ingest purchase CSV files, map product IDs to class IDs per environment, insert purchase records into Convex DB, trigger WhatsApp term acceptance messages, move processed files, log ingestion runs, and provide an admin UI for monitoring.

userStories.title: S3 polling scheduled action
userStories.description: As the system, I want to poll S3 for new CSV files on a schedule so that purchases are ingested automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: A Convex scheduled action in convex/s3Ingestion.ts runs every 5 minutes via convex/crons.ts
It connects to AWS S3 using credentials from Convex env vars: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
S3 bucket name is read from Convex env var S3_BUCKET_NAME (value: mart-order-887306483832-ap-southeast-1-an)
File key prefix is {ENV}/new/ where ENV is read from Convex env var APP_ENV (dev | uat | prod)
The action uses 'use node' directive (required for AWS SDK)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: S3 error alerting
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to be alerted when the S3 bucket is unreachable so that I can investigate connectivity or credential issues promptly.
acceptanceCriteria: If the S3 ListObjectsV2 call fails (network error, auth error, bucket not found), the error is logged with full details (error message, timestamp, APP_ENV)
An ingestion run record is written to the ingestion_runs table with status: 'error' and the error message stored
The polling continues on the next schedule tick (error does not crash the scheduler)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Product-to-class ID mapping config
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a per-environment mapping from product IDs to internal class IDs so that purchase records are linked to the correct class.
acceptanceCriteria: A config file convex/productMapping.ts exports a mapping object keyed by environment (dev, uat, prod)
Each entry maps external product IDs (strings) to internal class_id strings
Mapping is used during CSV ingestion to resolve class_id before inserting the purchase
If a product ID is not found in the mapping, the ingestion logs a warning and skips that row (does not crash)
File includes a comment with an example mapping structure for developer reference
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CSV parsing and purchase insertion
userStories.description: As the system, I want to parse each row in a purchase CSV and insert a purchase record so that the customer can receive their term acceptance message.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV columns parsed: order_id, product_id, user_phone, qty, unit_price, total (with trimming of whitespace around values, as the sample CSV has spaces after commas)
Each row is treated as an independent purchase record (one row = one purchase)
The same order_id can appear on multiple rows (one per product) — each gets its own purchase record
For each valid row, the system calls the shared createPurchase mutation (US-005)
qty is parsed as an integer and stored as participant_count
user_phone is stored as-is (already E.164 format, e.g. +85254304789)
Rows with unknown product IDs are skipped with a warning log (file still continues processing)
purchase_datetime is parsed from the CSV filename: format is YYYYMMDDHHmm---<uuid>.csv, e.g. 202603271622 → 2026-03-27T16:22:00
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Shared createPurchase mutation (payment-gateway ready)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reusable Convex mutation for creating purchases so that both S3 ingestion and the future direct payment gateway share the same logic.
acceptanceCriteria: A Convex mutation convex/purchases.ts: createPurchase accepts: order_id (string), customer_mobile (string), participant_count (number), class_id (optional string), source ('s3' | 'payment_gateway'), unit_price (optional number), total_price (optional number), purchase_datetime (string ISO 8601)
The mutation generates a UUID v4 token, sets status: 'pending_terms', and inserts the purchase
It returns the new purchase._id
purchase_datetime is supplied by the caller
The source field is stored in the purchase record for auditing — add source: v.optional(v.union(v.literal('s3'), v.literal('payment_gateway'))) to the purchases table in convex/schema.ts
Duplicate detection: if the same order_id + class_id combination already exists, skip and return existing _id (idempotent — safe for reprocessing)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Move processed files in S3
userStories.description: As the system, I want to move successfully processed CSV files to {ENV}/processed/ so that they are not reprocessed on the next poll.
acceptanceCriteria: After all rows in a file are attempted, the file is copied to {ENV}/processed/{original-filename} in S3
The original file is then deleted from {ENV}/new/
If the copy or delete fails, the error is logged but polling continues (file will be reprocessed next tick — idempotency in US-005 prevents duplicates)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Trigger WhatsApp term acceptance message after purchase creation
userStories.description: As the system, I want to send a WhatsApp message to the customer after a purchase record is created so that they can accept terms and select a session.
acceptanceCriteria: After createPurchase succeeds, the ingestion action calls the existing purchaseConfirmation:sendPurchaseConfirmation action with the new purchase_id
If WhatsApp sending fails, the purchase record remains in the database with status: 'pending_terms' (not rolled back)
The WhatsApp failure is logged with order_id and error details
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ingestion run logging in database
userStories.description: As the system, I want to persist a log of every ingestion run so that admins can audit history.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ingestion_runs table to convex/schema.ts with fields: run_at (number), status ('success' | 'partial' | 'error'), files_processed (number), rows_inserted (number), rows_skipped (number), error_message (optional string)
Every S3 poll writes one ingestion_runs record on completion (success or error)
status: 'partial' is used when some rows failed/were skipped but others succeeded
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Admin ingestion monitoring UI
userStories.description: As a super admin, I want to see a log of recent S3 ingestion runs and trigger a manual poll so that I can diagnose issues without waiting for the next scheduled run.
acceptanceCriteria: New admin page at /admin/ingestion/page.tsx
Page shows a table of the last 20 ingestion runs with columns: timestamp, status (colour-coded: green=success, yellow=partial, red=error), files processed, rows inserted, rows skipped, error message
A 'Poll Now' button triggers an immediate S3 poll (calls the ingestion action directly)
The 'Poll Now' button is only visible and functional to users with role: 'super_admin' — determined using the existing admin auth context
Page is linked from the admin nav (app/admin/admin-nav.tsx)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Filter sessions to upcoming dates only in terms acceptance form
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to only see upcoming (future) sessions when accepting terms, so I do not accidentally select a past session.
acceptanceCriteria: In convex/terms.ts getTermsPageData, after filtering by status === "scheduled" and available_quota > 0, add a filter to exclude sessions where date+time is in the past
A session is considered upcoming if new Date(`${session.date}T${session.time}`) > new Date() at query time
Past sessions (even if still scheduled with available quota) are excluded from the list
All existing filters remain: status === "scheduled", available_quota > 0, sorted by date+time ascending
Typecheck passes
Tests pass: add a test verifying past sessions are excluded from results

userStories.title: Return empty session list when purchase has no class_id

acceptanceCriteria: In convex/terms.ts getTermsPageData, if purchase.class_id is null/undefined/empty string, return an empty sessions array instead of querying all sessions
No sessions are shown when there is no class mapping on the purchase
The terms form still renders with a no-available-sessions message — it does not error
Typecheck passes
Test added verifying empty sessions array returned when purchase has no class_id

userStories.title: Replace Twilio WhatsApp provider with ManyChat
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to send WhatsApp messages via ManyChat using an approved template instead of Twilio free-form messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/manychat.ts with sendTermsAcceptanceWhatsApp({ to, termsUrl }) function

userStories.title: Handle ManyChat subscriber already exists error and resolve subscriber ID

acceptanceCriteria: In lib/manychat.ts, when createSubscriber returns HTTP 400 with "WhatsApp ID already exists": extract the wa_id from the error response and retry findBySystemField with field_name="wa_id" and the extracted value (without + prefix)

Update initial findBySystemField to also try phone without + prefix as a fallback if the first attempt fails
Log each lookup attempt and result clearly
If subscriber ID resolved via any path, proceed to sendContent as normal
If all lookups fail, log error and return false

userStories.title: Set phone field on createSubscriber so findBySystemField works for future lookups
